runtimes.value: mlx-video (I2V-14B, converted from the original checkpoint; quantized 4/8-bit at 81 frames gives black videos, bf16 fine, #40 open); ComfyUI native (a diffusers user confirmed I2V works in ComfyUI on MPS; Wan 2.x MPS corruption reports #15793 open); Draw Things (14B series, community hne/lne I2V configs); stable-diffusion.cpp (Metal, Comfy-Org or GGUF); diffusers WanImageToVideoPipeline on MPS (worked after pinning transformers 4.57.1 and PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1, diffusers#12896); DiffSynth-Studio. Official Wan2.2 code: no MPS
runtimes.note: mlx-video needs the original Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B repo (.pth T5 and VAE). kijai WanVideoWrapper: open I2V bf16 mismatch on macOS (#2018) and fp8 not supported on MPS (#963).
